def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    stock_price = 48.6
    strike_price = 45
    time_to_expiration = 0.25
    risk_free_rate = 0.003
    n_d1 = 0.6352
    n_d2 = 0.5486

    # Calculate the put value using the Black-Scholes formula
    from math import exp

    put_value = (
        strike_price
        * exp(-risk_free_rate * time_to_expiration)
        * (1 - n_d2)
        - stock_price * (1 - n_d1)
    )

    # return answer
    return round(put_value, 3)
